question: With regard to the alkaloids derived from ergoline:

options.opa: They can be obtained by fermentation of pure Claviceps purpurea cultures and derived from phenylalanine and isoprene obtained by the mevalonic acid route (MVA).
options.opb: They can be obtained by fermentation of pure cultures of Claviceps purpurea and derived from tyrosine and isoprene obtained by the DOXP route.
options.opc: They can be obtained by fermentation of pure cultures of Claviceps purpurea and derived from tryptophan and isoprene obtained by the route of mevalonic acid (MVA).
options.opd: They can be obtained by rye infection with Claviceps purpurea spores and derived from tryptophan and isoprene obtained by the DOXP route.
options.ope: They can be obtained by wheat infection with Claviceps purpurea spores and derived from tyrosine and isoprene obtained by the mevalonic acid (MVA) route.
